purchase.label: Purchase
purchase.description: Conformance vectors for completing an Ordex public ask. Each case names a transaction shape, the order terms, and the exact verdict a compatible verifier must reach. The rules verified here are stated in spec/purchase.md.

cases.name: arrangement-ordex-builds
cases.title: arrangement-ordex-builds
cases.description: The exact arrangement the gateway composes: two padding inputs, the offered output at index 2, funding behind it, and outputs that absorb padding plus the offered value ahead of the seller payment. The invariant holds with equality.

case.name: arrangement-ordex-builds
case.description: The exact arrangement the gateway composes: two padding inputs, the offered output at index 2, funding behind it, and outputs that absorb padding plus the offered value ahead of the seller payment. The invariant holds with equality.

cases.name: surplus-ahead-of-payment
cases.title: surplus-ahead-of-payment
cases.description: Outputs ahead of the payment absorb more than the offered range. Wasteful, but the asset still lands in a buyer output, so it verifies.

case.name: surplus-ahead-of-payment
case.description: Outputs ahead of the payment absorb more than the offered range. Wasteful, but the asset still lands in a buyer output, so it verifies.

cases.name: offered-input-first
cases.title: offered-input-first
cases.description: The offered output is the first input, so its sats are the first paid out and they land inside the payment returning to the seller. Valid to a node, and the buyer receives nothing.

case.name: offered-input-first
case.description: The offered output is the first input, so its sats are the first paid out and they land inside the payment returning to the seller. Valid to a node, and the buyer receives nothing.

cases.name: shortfall-by-one-sat
cases.title: shortfall-by-one-sat
cases.description: The outputs ahead of the payment fall one sat short of the offered range. The last sat of the asset's output, and whatever rides on it, would reach the seller.

case.name: shortfall-by-one-sat
case.description: The outputs ahead of the payment fall one sat short of the offered range. The last sat of the asset's output, and whatever rides on it, would reach the seller.

cases.name: payment-at-wrong-index
cases.title: payment-at-wrong-index
cases.description: The seller payment output exists, but not at the index the seller's input occupies. The signature commits to the output at its own index, so this transaction carries an invalid signature and, were it valid, would misroute the sats.

case.name: payment-at-wrong-index
case.description: The seller payment output exists, but not at the index the seller's input occupies. The signature commits to the output at its own index, so this transaction carries an invalid signature and, were it valid, would misroute the sats.

cases.name: underpaid-seller
cases.title: underpaid-seller
cases.description: The output at the shared index pays the right script but one sat below the asking price. The seller's signature does not commit to it.

case.name: underpaid-seller
case.description: The output at the shared index pays the right script but one sat below the asking price. The seller's signature does not commit to it.

cases.name: offered-outpoint-missing
cases.title: offered-outpoint-missing
cases.description: No input spends the offered output. Whatever this transaction is, it does not complete this ask.

case.name: offered-outpoint-missing
case.description: No input spends the offered output. Whatever this transaction is, it does not complete this ask.

cases.name: offered-outpoint-duplicated
cases.title: offered-outpoint-duplicated
cases.description: The offered outpoint appears at two indexes. One signature would answer for two positions, so the transaction is refused before any further reasoning.

case.name: offered-outpoint-duplicated
case.description: The offered outpoint appears at two indexes. One signature would answer for two positions, so the transaction is refused before any further reasoning.

cases.name: no-output-at-shared-index
cases.title: no-output-at-shared-index
cases.description: The offered input sits at an index past the last output, so no output can carry the payment the signature commits to.

case.name: no-output-at-shared-index
case.description: The offered input sits at an index past the last output, so no output can carry the payment the signature commits to.

cases.name: unreadable-input-value
cases.title: unreadable-input-value
cases.description: The value of an input ahead of the offered one could not be read. The invariant cannot be evaluated, and unknown is refused rather than guessed.

case.name: unreadable-input-value
case.description: The value of an input ahead of the offered one could not be read. The invariant cannot be evaluated, and unknown is refused rather than guessed.

cases.name: fractional-value-refused
cases.title: fractional-value-refused
cases.description: An amount written as a fraction is not an atomic integer. It is refused as unreadable rather than rounded.

case.name: fractional-value-refused
case.description: An amount written as a fraction is not an atomic integer. It is refused as unreadable rather than rounded.

cases.name: arrangement-core-native-single-dummy
cases.title: arrangement-core-native-single-dummy
cases.description: Core's native Ordinals purchase layout: one buyer dummy input ahead of the seller's asset, the receiver output absorbing dummy plus asset, then the seller payout, service fee and change. The shared index is 1, not 2 - the rule is the seller's own index, never a fixed position.

case.name: arrangement-core-native-single-dummy
case.description: Core's native Ordinals purchase layout: one buyer dummy input ahead of the seller's asset, the receiver output absorbing dummy plus asset, then the seller payout, service fee and change. The shared index is 1, not 2 - the rule is the seller's own index, never a fixed position.

cases.name: core-native-receiver-one-sat-short
cases.title: core-native-receiver-one-sat-short
cases.description: The same Core layout with a receiver output one sat below the dummy plus asset total. The last sat of the offered range would land in the seller's payment, so the buyer would not receive the whole inscription's output.

case.name: core-native-receiver-one-sat-short
case.description: The same Core layout with a receiver output one sat below the dummy plus asset total. The last sat of the offered range would land in the seller's payment, so the buyer would not receive the whole inscription's output.

cases.name: nonzero-asset-offset-inside-offered-output
cases.title: nonzero-asset-offset-inside-offered-output
cases.description: The inscription sits part way into the offered output rather than on its first sat. The rule does not need to know the offset: absorbing the whole offered range ahead of the payment carries the asset wherever inside that range it sits.

case.name: nonzero-asset-offset-inside-offered-output
case.description: The inscription sits part way into the offered output rather than on its first sat. The rule does not need to know the offset: absorbing the whole offered range ahead of the payment carries the asset wherever inside that range it sits.

cases.name: insufficient-padding-ahead-of-offered-input
cases.title: insufficient-padding-ahead-of-offered-input
cases.description: The Ordex two-padding layout with padding outputs too small to absorb the padding inputs plus the offered output. Part of the offered range would reach the seller payment.

case.name: insufficient-padding-ahead-of-offered-input
case.description: The Ordex two-padding layout with padding outputs too small to absorb the padding inputs plus the offered output. Part of the offered range would reach the seller payment.

cases.name: seller-payout-raised-above-the-ask
cases.title: seller-payout-raised-above-the-ask
cases.description: A payout altered upwards is refused exactly like one altered downwards: the seller's signature commits to the asking price, and any other value is a different transaction than the one they signed.

case.name: seller-payout-raised-above-the-ask
case.description: A payout altered upwards is refused exactly like one altered downwards: the seller's signature commits to the asking price, and any other value is a different transaction than the one they signed.

cases.name: malformed-input-entry-ahead-of-offered
cases.title: malformed-input-entry-ahead-of-offered
cases.description: An input entry ahead of the offered index is not an object at all. The verifier answers with a verdict rather than throwing, because a caller handing it an unparsed or hostile transaction must get a refusal it can act on.

case.description: An input entry ahead of the offered index is not an object at all. The verifier answers with a verdict rather than throwing, because a caller handing it an unparsed or hostile transaction must get a refusal it can act on.
